pages.title: "Type 30" CIWS
pages.text: $(br2)A rotary cannon turret with an extremely high rate of fire and very fast target switching, also known as a Point-Defense Turret (PDT).$(br2)It fires small-caliber electromagnetically propelled rounds and functions only on a subspace.

Supports multiple targeting modes. In Defense mode, it automatically intercepts projectiles traveling toward its current subspace.$(br2)Extremely effective against entities and projectiles, but unable to attack hostile subspaces.$(br2)Maximum targeting distance/range: 256 blocks.$(br2)The research team raised an interesting question: what happens if four CIWS barrel assemblies and four times the feed mechanism are mounted on one enormous base?
